note: Starter vocabulary — SPEC.md §16 leaves the exact term set open. Expected to grow as the catalog does. What matters is the mechanism: an unlisted tag fails the build naming the file to fix. A generation may carry more than one term (a range spanning saloon + estate + coupe).

terms.label: Saloon
terms.description: Three-box body with a separate boot compartment.

terms.label: Hatchback
terms.description: Two-box body with a rear liftgate opening into the cabin.

terms.label: Liftback
terms.description: Saloon-like profile with a hatch-style rear opening.

terms.label: Estate
terms.description: Extended roofline over a full-height load bay.

terms.label: Coupé
terms.description: Two-door fixed-roof body, typically with a lower roofline than the saloon it derives from.

terms.label: Convertible
terms.description: Folding soft or hard roof over a full body.

terms.label: Roadster
terms.description: Two-seat open body, minimal weather equipment.

terms.label: Targa
terms.description: Removable roof panel with a fixed rear structure or roll hoop.

terms.label: Shooting brake
terms.description: Coupé profile with an estate-style extended roof.

terms.label: SUV
terms.description: High-riding body, traditionally body-on-frame or with genuine off-road intent.

terms.label: Crossover
terms.description: High-riding body on a unibody car platform.

terms.label: MPV
terms.description: Tall one-box body prioritising interior volume and seating rows.

terms.label: Pickup
terms.description: Cab with an open cargo bed.

terms.label: Van
terms.description: Passenger or combi derivative of a commercial van body.

terms.label: Microcar
terms.description: Body sized to a regulatory class rather than a market segment.
